lesson.summary: The big picture — then two quick questions to unlock your Business X-Ray

resource.title: Watch: how your AI Employee actually works

contents.bodyMd:
Before the Business X-Ray, watch this overview — it shows how handing AI **one map of your business** turns it from a tool you babysit into an employee that runs the work. Below the video is exactly **why that map matters and how it works** — then two quick questions to continue.

## Why you give AI a Business Map

A business map is one file plus a set of department folders — a model of how your whole business runs and how it makes money (Leads → Appointments → Presentations → Sales). It's the single thing that turns AI from a *tool* into an *employee*.

> [!WARNING]
> **Without a map**
> - Your AI doesn't know where anything lives or how you make money, so you hand-hold every task. **You stay the router** — every request runs through you.

> [!TIP]
> **With a map (how it works)**
> - A request comes in → your AI reads the map, opens the right department, pulls what it needs, and does the work — the way an employee would. That's how it handles most of your requests **without you in the loop**.

You already started this

- When you ran `/setup-aieb`, it created and verified your **starting workspace frame** in the attached Project folder.
- The **Business X-Ray** (next) fills that frame with *your* business — how it actually runs and the first job to hand off.

Quick check — make sure the mechanism clicked

1. With your business map in place, what changes about how a request gets handled?

Nothing changes — you still walk your AI through every step Your AI reads the map, opens the right department, and does the work on its own — instead of every task routing through you It replies faster, but only for marketing tasks

2. What must be true before your Cowork workspace is ready for the Business X-Ray?

The connector says Connected, even if no Project folder is attached Claude names the attached Project folder and verifies the saved workspace state can be read back there
